name: Software RAID Degraded (mdadm)
description: Catches mdadm monitor events for a degraded array, a failed member or spare and a vanished device, and the kernel's disk failure notice for md arrays. Needs mdadm --monitor (enabled by most distributions).
match_pattern: (?:DegradedArray|Fail|FailSpare|DeviceDisappeared) event detected on md device|md/raid\d*:\S+: Disk failure on
